name: Azure Alert Suppression
description: Azure Monitor and Microsoft Defender let you suppress alerts so noisy rules stop paging. An attacker who creates a suppression rule first is asking the platform not to wake you when they act next. The suppression often looks like a tuning change. If a new suppression appears and then privileged activity follows, the suppression was the setup. Only a small ops group should be allowed to mute detections.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
